infotexts.entitydescription.aegisvacuum: Two-handed suction tool with a replaceable battery. Requires an Aegis salvage backpack in your inventory and LuaCs. Aim and hold use to collect. Press F to open storage. The vacuum battery also powers salvage.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisvacuumpack: Storage for the Aegis vacuum: 100 groups of up to 100 actual items. Preserves loaded crates and equipment condition. Craft backpack and vacuum separately. The battery belongs in the vacuum.
infotexts.vacuum.title: Aegis vacuum storage
infotexts.entitydescription.combatmultitool: Two-handed ricocheting energy-ring emitter and shield. Requires Lua for Barotrauma. One cell or fuel rod powers weapons, shield, light and tools. Quality grants 1/2/3/4 bounces. Players disable NPC damage to weld/cut. Extinguisher takes priority over firing. Bots automatically select combat or one technical function for their actual task. While held and powered, grants +2 to all five skills every 5 minutes; shared progress with the composite multi-tool.
infotexts.entitydescription.Multi-toolSET: A composite tool; toggle welder/cutter, shine a built-in flashlight beam, enable extinguisher mode, and use a shared oxygen tank. With a usable fuel rod, holding it grants +2 to all five skills every 5 minutes. Passive training requires Lua for Barotrauma and shares progress with Aegis.
infotexts.entitydescription.wrenchscrewdrivertwoin: Designed for submarine engineers, double right-click to switch wrenches/screwdrivers.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisheadset: Standard-range radio with one battery-cell slot. While equipped in the headset slot, spends energy on pressure protection and gradual health regeneration. The small LED blinks red during protection and blue during healing. Wearing it has no passive cost. A full standard cell provides about 40 seconds of pressure protection alone. Alarms at 20%, 10% and empty. Bots replace cells at 10% or less. Neurotrauma and other medical mods are optional. Radio works without a battery. Requires client and server LuaCs.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisheadsetmk2: Advanced regenerative headset. Heals injuries and diseases 4 times faster and restores anatomy 50% faster than the basic model. All powered actions use 60% less energy than earlier Mk II models. Also absorbs native attacks from every direction, spending battery power according to incoming strength. Insufficient power lets part of the damage through. Three small LEDs blink red on impacts and blue during healing. The battery powers absorption, regeneration and pressure protection; wearing it has no passive cost. Medical mods are optional. Requires client and server LuaCs.
